props.gloss_en: had it taught the eggshell only: there the Rabbis forbid, since it is not repulsive one will come to take from it; but earthenware, which is repulsive, say they agree with R' Yehuda -- so the earthenware clause teaches they forbid even that
had it taught earthenware only: there R' Yehuda permits, but in the other [the eggshell] say he agrees with the Rabbis -- so the eggshell clause teaches he permits even that
had it taught those two only: there R' Yehuda permits because it is not separated, but a bowl, which is separated, say he agrees with the Rabbis -- so the bowl clause teaches he permits even that
had it taught that [the bowl] only: there the Rabbis forbid, but in those two say they agree with R' Yehuda -- so the tube clauses teach they forbid even those. [All are] necessary
